record_title: Exact isotropy for inner-shear derivations of the free associative plane
provenance: A two-parameter polynomial family extends the free-associative counterexamples in arXiv:2609.19470v1 and admits exact kernel, local-nilpotence, and isotropy classifications.
limitations: Originality is qualified to the best of our knowledge. The relevant free-associative section of arXiv:2609.19470v1 and adjacent centralizer and locally-nilpotent-derivation literature were checked, but older free-associative derivation or automorphism literature may contain an equivalent family in different notation. The Crode--Shestakov article was not exhaustively inspected beyond its published description. No independent validation is asserted.
